comment: The professor explains lessons very clearly and is always willing to help students who are struggling.
Our instructor is very patient and makes even difficult topics easy to understand.
I appreciate how the teacher gives detailed feedback on our projects.
The professor is often late to class and rushes through the lecture.
Some instructors do not respond to emails or messages for consultation.
The teacher's grading system is unclear and inconsistent.
The class schedule is fine but the topics discussed are just average.
The professor follows the syllabus and covers the required topics.
Our teacher is knowledgeable but sometimes speaks too fast during lectures.
I love how our professor uses real world examples to explain the lesson.
The instructor rarely gives updates about our grades.
Lectures are okay, nothing special but nothing bad either.
The registrar staff were very accommodating when I asked about my enrollment.
The guidance office staff patiently answered all my questions.
Staff at the library are helpful and always ready to assist students.
The staff at the records office was rude when I asked for my transcript.
It took forever for the staff to process my request, very disorganized.
Some staff members ignore students waiting in line.
The staff processed my documents within the expected time frame.
Front desk staff followed the standard procedure for my request.
The office staff was courteous and explained the requirements clearly.
Staff response time was slow but they eventually resolved my concern.
I had a bad experience with an unfriendly staff member at the clinic.
The IT support staff quickly fixed my account access issue.
The cashier explained the payment breakdown clearly and was very kind.
Online payment portal is convenient and easy to use.
I like that the school offers flexible installment plans.
The payment system crashed multiple times during enrollment.
Long queues at the cashier caused me to miss my class.
There is no clear receipt given after paying tuition fees.
The payment process took the usual amount of time, nothing unusual.
Tuition fee breakdown is available but hard to find on the portal.
Refund process was smooth and staff explained each step.
Payment confirmation emails are delayed for several days.
The billing statement matches what was discussed during enrollment.
Extremely disappointed with how payment concerns are handled.
The classrooms are clean and well ventilated.
Wifi connection in the campus is fast and reliable.
The library has a wide collection of books and a quiet study area.
Restrooms are often dirty and lack proper supplies.
The aircon in our room has been broken for weeks.
Parking space is very limited during peak hours.
The laboratory equipment is outdated but still functional.
Classrooms have the basic furniture needed for lectures.
Cafeteria food is average, could use more variety.
I love studying in the new student lounge, it's spacious and comfortable.
Elevators are frequently out of service which is inconvenient.
The gymnasium is well maintained and used for various events.
The professor is strict but fair when it comes to grading.
I did not learn much this semester because lectures felt disorganized.
The staff went above and beyond to help me find my lost ID.
Requesting documents from the registrar is a slow and tedious process.
I appreciate the discount given for early payment of tuition.
There were errors in my billing statement that took weeks to correct.
Signages around the campus could be improved for new students.
The new computer laboratory has updated and fast computers.
Our professor provides extra review sessions before major exams.
The clinic staff acted quickly when a student fainted during class.
Cashiering hours are limited which is inconvenient for working students.
Overall the campus facilities meet the basic needs of students.
